Repo path: frontendv2/public/icanhasfeatherpanel/plugins/

## Core docs

- [AI guide](./ai-guide.md): Dense checklist, pitfalls, validation rules for AI agents
- [Getting started](./getting-started.md): Directory layout, create flow, minimal plugin
- [conf.yml](./conf-yml.md): Manifest schema, flags, dependencies, admin config fields
- [Backend](./backend.md): AppPlugin lifecycle, routes, events, settings, migrations, cron, CLI
- [Frontend](./frontend.md): widgets.json, sidebar.json, public.json, ui.json, theme.json
- [Power SDK](./power-sdk.md): window.FeatherPanel events, actions, API, modals, shortcuts
- [Packaging](./packaging.md): .fpa packages, install/update, Public/Components symlinks
- [Recipes](./recipes.md): Copy-paste minimal API + widget + sidebar examples
- [Index](./README.md): Reading order
